high_level_description: The image is a cover of Men's Health magazine featuring a person sitting on a turquoise and white striped beach chair. The individual has short, spiky red hair and is wearing a sleeveless dark blue shirt that reveals extensive tattoos on their arms and legs. The tattoos include various designs and text, with some characters appearing to be in Arabic script. They are also wearing a silver watch on their left wrist and a ring on the ring finger of their right hand. The person is dressed casually in light blue and white sneakers with pink stripes on the socks.
